data: In the leftmost plot, which of the following lines show the highest score by the end of the graph?

The question asks about the line showing the highest score by the end of the graph in the leftmost plot. The leftmost plot is the first graph in the compound figure. 

Looking at the leftmost plot, there are two lines representing different classifiers: one for the 'Normal Classifier' (blue) and another for the 'Embedded Classifier' (red). Both lines show an upward trend over time but reach different levels at the end of the graph. 

By visually inspecting the graph, the red line (Embedded Classifier) appears to reach a higher score than the blue line (Normal Classifier) by the end of the graph. Therefore, the Embedded Classifier shows the highest score by the end of the graph.
